claims.statement: North Tower has a watch bell.
Tarin reports seeing Sella place an unlabeled paper envelope on the Lantern Harbor registry desk.
Tarin reports that Sella placed an unlabeled paper envelope on the Lantern Harbor registry desk during Bell-7, the sole seventh-watch registry-bell sounding on the seventh day of Embermonth, year 12.
Vela reports hearing two strokes she took to be the registry bell during Bell-7 and reports not seeing Sella or an envelope.

Vela reports reading “KEEP THE EAST GATE CLEAR” on a slate and tentatively inferring from its cramped letters that its unknown writer might have been hurried; she says she could not tell who wrote it.
Jorin, who identifies himself as a registrar, reports seeing Vela standing on the Lantern Harbor east steps during what he called Bell-7; he reports not seeing who, if anyone, struck a bell.
Jorin reports that he was sent to copy a gate notice, read “KEEP THE EAST GATE OPEN” on a slate at the east steps, and did not see who put it there.
